steps: Reverify exact binding metadata. Narrow the existing shared CRON_SECRET target to Preview only, preserving its stored value. If a value is required, stop without decrypting/copying it.
Operator enters and saves a new random 32+ character Production-only Secret CRON_SECRET in the prepared Vercel form and stores it privately.
Verify scopes by names/types/targets only; preserve testing override and existing Preview value.
Build a new protected public-origin artifact of exact validated source 082c225 with normal schedule, backups enabled, test mode off, backfill off and skip-domain; preserve all current aliases.
Use separately entered private key for the same approved temporary-access wrong/correct-key dry-run. Revoke temporary access and remove the key file/server after checking.
limitations: Existing immutable deployments retain old captured keys. This is not global credential revocation.
Any future external Production cron caller must use the new key after cutover.
New bindings require a new build; saved settings do not update existing deployments.
